culprit_citations.quoted_text: Centric Brands L.P. Class A LP Interests | 5.3% | Fair Value 23,777,334

findings.detail: The filing reports percent of net assets to one decimal, so exact row identities differ from fair value divided by net assets solely because of disclosed rounding.

rationale: The raw schedule is internally consistent. Total fair value of $1,239,482,127 divided by net assets of $446,855,336 is 277.38%, which rounds to the filed 277.4%. A representative position has fair value $23,777,334, equal to 5.321% of net assets and correctly printed as 5.3%. The 100% violation rate across 47 units therefore reflects a check that does not accommodate the filing's one-decimal percentage precision, rather than erroneous extracted values.
